      rw [(by push_cast; ring : (π * I * n ^ 2 * τ : ℂ) = (π * n ^ 2 : ℝ) * (τ * I)),

  · have : n ^ 2 = (n.natAbs ^ 2 :) := by rw [Nat.cast_pow, Int.natAbs_sq]
    rw [this, zpow_natCast]
